bio: Prix fixe presentations seem to be ascendant these days, but this Italian restaurant boasts an unstinting menu of à la carte offerings. The list of pastas is so extensive that you can find a new one every time you visit, while gelato comes in plenty of flavours. Staff provide attentive service, ensuring that guests can always enjoy delicious items when they want them without hesitation. The name ‘ess.’ is short for ‘essential’, and that’s the experience this restaurant brings you....
